tools.name: clear_webhooks
tools.description: Permanently delete every capture in a bucket. Requires confirm=true.

confirm.description: must be true to perform this destructive action

tools.name: configure_webhook_response
tools.description: Set the status, content type (JSON, plain text, XML, or form-encoded), body, optional Retry-After or X-Hook-Secret header, and a delay up to 10 seconds returned by the webhook endpoint. Browser visits always receive plain text.

content_type.description: application/json, text/plain, application/xml, text/xml, application/soap+xml, application/problem+xml, application/x-www-form-urlencoded, or application/*+json; only a charset parameter is allowed; empty selects application/json

headers.description: optional response headers; only Retry-After and X-Hook-Secret are supported, matched case-insensitively

delay_ms.description: response delay in milliseconds, from 0 to 10000

tools.name: create_webhook_bucket
tools.description: Create an anonymous temporary webhook capture bucket. The returned bucket ID is a bearer capability and expires after 15 days of inactivity.

name.description: optional display name for the bucket

controlled_test.description: set true only for maintainer QA or automated evaluations; not for a real user's first test

tools.name: delete_webhook_bucket
tools.description: Permanently delete a bucket and all of its captures. Requires confirm=true.

confirm.description: must be true to perform this destructive action

tools.name: get_webhook
tools.description: Read one webhook capture scoped to its bucket. Sensitive headers and query values are redacted by default.

include_sensitive.description: return sensitive header and query values; defaults to false

max_body_bytes.description: maximum body bytes to return; defaults to 65536 and cannot exceed 262144

tools.name: get_webhook_bucket
tools.description: Read a bucket name and its configured HTTP response settings.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: List webhook capture summaries in newest-first order using cursor pagination.

limit.description: number of summaries to return, from 1 to 50

cursor.description: opaque cursor returned by a previous call

tools.name: wait_for_webhook
tools.description: Return the latest capture, wait for a newer capture, or report received=false after the timeout.

after_webhook_id.description: wait for a capture newer than this webhook ID

wait_seconds.description: seconds to wait; defaults to 20 and cannot exceed 25
